scope: Source fidelity of schematic facade segment and actual front/elevation renders. Not a measured survey, independent numerical mesh audit, or physical print test.

reference.inspection: Actual 800x450 official photo pixels compared against completed front and front-elevation renders

findings.observation: Two-storey red-brick arcade, upper broad/narrow/broad/narrow/broad/broad sequence, flatter lower broad arches, lower narrow rectangular openings, light turned balustrades and open second-broad ground entrance agree with visible source.

Four broad bays use equal nominal3.8 widths and rounded semicircular upper crowns. Avoids copying oblique-photo left-to-right enlargement into a frontal elevation. README/SOURCES explicitly disclose this as normalization assumption, not measured equality or surveyed radii.

Actual front and elevation renders show continuous masonry above upper crowns below corbels. Source visible masonry separation is retained. Build parameters crown8.0 and corbel-bottom8.22 preserve clearance.

Shallow depth, flat plinth, back/end closure, shadow backing and simplified baluster/corbel counts are authored approximations. Side arcade, rear plan, full roof, stair geometry and interior are not reconstructed. These omissions and assumptions are disclosed.
School1909 and municipal1906 statements are not merged; both public page URLs are cited. Date discrepancy does not establish a surveyed historical model state.

limitations: Single photographic view; same-view school reencoding is not independent corroboration.
All dimensional proportions, material colors, exact baluster counts and cornice carving remain approximate.
No approval implied for full-building or measured-accuracy claims.
Reference photograph is privately inspected and not redistributed in model package.
overall: Acceptable as an explicitly approximate source-informed six-bay facade study, subject to stated limitations and separate file/geometry QA. Any changes to reviewed files require hash renewal and relevant re-review.
